verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local model server with a REST API, so assigning a custom identifier or alias to a loaded model is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents a REST API for running and managing models, model hot-swapping, and pull/rm commands. Nothing in it shows a way to give a model a custom name or alias for consistent reference in API calls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a custom identifier to a loaded model for consistent reference in API calls
